duplicateAnnotationDiscrepancy.resolution: Both annotations use the identical underlying photograph (1000145311.jpg). The primary annotation ('NE corner of the plot', 'North 12 m road', 'East 9 m road') is owner-confirmed and matches the video pan (V02/V05). The alternate red-text annotation ('Wall turns from here') is preserved in the evidence register as an unconfirmed alternate interpretation and is not used to alter the locked 40 x 50 ft plot boundary.
